razer - wolverine v4 tournament edition.description: The Razer Wolverine V4 Tournament Edition is a wired esports controller designed for Xbox Series X|S and PC players who demand speed, precision, and customization. Built for competitive shooters, racing simulators, sports games, and action titles, it delivers the responsiveness and control needed to perform consistently under pressure. Capacitive thumbstick sensors provide high-resolution accuracy with a contactless design engineered to resist stick drift. Whether you're tracking opponents in FPS titles or making precise movements in platforming games, every input feels smooth and controlled. Gain a competitive edge with four mouse-click back buttons and two claw grip bumpers. These extra inputs can be customized to keep important actions within easy reach, reducing hand movement and helping maintain control during fast-paced gameplay. Dual-mode trigger locks allow quick switching between instant mouse-click actuation and full-range trigger travel. Choose rapid-fire responsiveness for competitive shooters or precise throttle and brake control for racing games.Micro-switch PBT action buttons deliver responsive actuation and satisfying tactile feedback, while the 8-way floating D-pad supports both accurate cardinal inputs and smooth diagonal movement. Unlock maximum wired performance on PC with up to 8000 Hz polling rate for faster reporting and lower input latency. Every movement, attack, and command is transmitted with exceptional speed and accuracy. Using Razer Synapse 4 and the Razer Controller App, players can create up to four custom profiles, adjust thumbstick dead zones, remap buttons, and optimize settings for different genres and playstyles.
